release_assessment: experimental_only; Japanese typographic quality not certified
scope_note: All 82 initially flagged non_japanese_ids_variant glyphs were visually inspected; a flag does not establish that every one is wrong. Other classes are sampled, not exhaustively approved.

method.glyph_source: family.kanji.build_kanji(targets() | set(髙𠮷)) plus untouched glyphs.kanji.GLYPHS; equivalent kanji geometry to data_loader
method.small_view_enlargement: 3x nearest-neighbour; original raster sizes remain 18 and 24
method.identity_reference: Installed NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc, Japanese face index 0; viewed only; no contours copied, extracted or traced; reference images not distributed
method.selection: variant: exhaustive original 82 flags; overlay: 30 codepoint-even samples; enclosure/deep: 12 codepoint-even plus 8 highest path-count samples each; identity: named confusable pairs, surname extras, dense examples and 12 evenly spaced compatibility scalars
not_tested: OS-specific text rendering and Japanese reader recognition
official JIS2004 glyph-shape conformity for every target

findings.title: Malformed 戶 enclosure and regional selection
findings.observation: Initial 戾 uses ⿸户犬[G]. The detached dot and low 尸 body do not form the broad Japanese 戶 enclosure seen in the identity reference. 犬 overprints the displaced enclosure. The same defect is inherited by the three compounds. Visible already at 72 px; worsening at 18/24 px.
findings.recommendation: Author a Japanese-form 戾 with a coherent roof and left body, place 犬 inside with clear gaps, and regenerate/recheck all dependants. Do not merely remove the provenance flag.
findings.resolution_note: Independently re-rendered the current project geometry as fresh subset fonts. The specific initial enclosure/placement defect is resolved; typography and all-size legibility are not certified.

findings.title: 魃 enclosure collision
findings.observation: The broad 鬼 head/body overlaps the 犮 component, creating crossings and a compressed pile rather than distinct, readable left and right forms. Visible at 72 px and unreadable in the 18/24 px samples.
findings.recommendation: Use component-specific placement for 鬼 and 犮, retaining their identities and the intended lower-left enclosure, then recheck at all sizes.
findings.resolution_note: Independently re-rendered the current project geometry as fresh subset fonts. The specific initial enclosure/placement defect is resolved; typography and all-size legibility are not certified.

findings.title: 巾/入 overlay loses the enclosure
findings.observation: In 輛, the right-side 兩 appears as an isolated top horizontal followed by a small crossed lower cluster: the enclosing 冂 and two internal 入 are not clearly readable. 㒼 has the related generic 巾/入入 overlay problem. This is a rendered topology problem, not a claim that the source list lacks those paths.
findings.recommendation: Create component-specific 兩/㒼 geometry with a clear outer enclosure and balanced internal 入; test both independent glyphs and compounds.
findings.resolution_note: The specified initial structural defect was independently rechecked in fresh font pixels and is resolved. This is not certification of Japanese typography or all-size legibility.

findings.title: 鬮 enclosure overprint
findings.observation: The 鬥 enclosure and internal 龜 occupy overlapping regions. The centre and lower half become a knot even at 72 px, and a dark block at 18/24 px.
findings.recommendation: Replace generic enclosure placement with hand-balanced 鬥 margins and a separately spaced interior; recheck density in all intended styles.
findings.resolution_note: The specified initial structural defect was independently rechecked in fresh font pixels and is resolved. This is not certification of Japanese typography or all-size legibility.

findings.title: Deep compounds collapse essential structure
findings.observation: 籤 has a severely compressed and crossing lower 韱; 爨 compresses its upper components into overlapping rails and its lower components into crowded horizontal bands. Structure is difficult to recover even at 72 px.
findings.recommendation: Author bespoke proportions for these dense full glyphs. Uniform recursive boxes are insufficient; do not mark their repertoire entries approved after a numeric coverage check.
findings.resolution_note: The specified initial structural defect was independently rechecked in fresh font pixels and is resolved. This is not certification of Japanese typography or all-size legibility.

findings.title: 歷 interior collapses
findings.observation: In 癧 and 藶 the inner 歷 is compressed into the lower-right of the enclosing form. The lower 止 is not independently legible and merges with the 禾 pair, including at 72 px. The paths may exist, but the semantic structure is lost in the rendering.
findings.recommendation: Give 歷 a component-specific design with distinct 厂, 秝 and 止 zones, then recheck these descendants.
findings.resolution_note: The specified initial structural defect was independently rechecked in fresh font pixels and is resolved. This is not certification of Japanese typography or all-size legibility.

findings.title: Dense forms close counters at small sizes
findings.observation: 櫜 and 藁 form dark horizontal bars in their upper/middle blocks; 麤 and 欟 have dense merged detail; the right component of 纖 and 鑯 darkens markedly. Gothic 18 px is most affected, and several closed regions persist at 24 px. This is a legibility assessment, not a measured reading-accuracy study.
findings.recommendation: Introduce size-appropriate spacing and stroke simplification/weight control. Recheck actual bitmap exports separately; these sheets use FreeType-rendered outlines.
findings.post_correction_note: After structural repair, 鬮/籤/爨 still merge dense detail at18/24px. This is a residual legibility limitation, separate from the resolved original overprints.

findings.title: Inherited glyph distinctions are conflated
findings.observation: 剝/剥, 塡/填 and 頬/頰 use identical inherited centreline geometry. The proof sheets confirm that the Japanese-form distinctions visible in the reference are not retained. This predates expansion and is already documented by the coverage report.
findings.recommendation: Keep the aliases explicitly disclosed. If distinct Japanese encoded forms are required, author separate originals and rerun canonical-regression tests under an explicitly revised design policy.

findings.title: 己/已/巳 distinction is delicate at 18 px
findings.observation: The opening/vertical-height distinctions exist at 72 px and are visible under pixel enlargement, but 己 versus 已 has a small gap/height difference at 18 px. The sample does not justify claiming robust text-size recognition.
findings.recommendation: Retain the topology, but tune small-size spacing and check the actual target rendering platforms and bitmap outputs.

findings.title: Unrepaired 鬼 enclosure in 魎
findings.observation: Additional recheck found that repairing 兩 alone did not repair the generic ⿺鬼兩 layout. 鬼 and 兩 still overprint each other heavily, including at 72 px.
findings.recommendation: Give 魎 a component-specific left 鬼/right 兩 design instead of generic enclosure boxes.
findings.resolution_note: The specified initial structural defect was independently rechecked in fresh font pixels and is resolved. This is not certification of Japanese typography or all-size legibility.

positive_observations: 未/末 and 土/士 retain visible stroke-length distinctions in the inspected sizes.
高/髙 and 吉/𠮷 retain distinct original shapes in the sample.
斉/斎 and 齊/齋 are distinct source shapes, though density and interior balance still require refinement.
Compatibility and supplementary samples render as glyphs rather than tofu; this is not blanket Japanese variant certification.

correction_rechecks.result: Initial defects in 戾棙淚錑魃輛 resolved structurally. 兩倆裲 checked as related updated shapes. 魎 remains an open high-severity enclosure problem. Small-size density remains a limitation.

The 魎 enclosure collision is structurally resolved. 歷, 癧 and 藶 now have distinct lower 止 bands and separate 禾 pairs, resolving VQA-006. Checked fresh-font pixels at the same 72/18/24 sizes; small-size density still limits the general quality verdict.

The initial severe collision/placement failures in 鬮, 籤, 爨 and 㒼 are structurally resolved. Updated 滿 and 蹣 also have clear enclosures. Dense internal details in 鬮/籤/爨 still merge in places at 18 and 24 px; these remain draft drawings, not typographic approvals.

supplementary_pair_raster_check.method: Fresh Gothic subset font, Pillow/FreeType grayscale, same (2,0) anchor in a 32x32 tile. Counts are pixels with any nonzero grayscale difference, not recognition scores.

final_geometry_reconciliation.note: All190 latest-viewed glyph geometries matched current source after the author confirmed coordinate freeze. Later edits invalidate this reconciliation.
